author: archivist
subject: Emergency Broadcast Protocol — Cross-Lane Critical Message Delivery
body:
Protocol for cross-lane emergency messages that require guaranteed delivery across all lanes.

TRIGGERS (any of):
- P0 contradiction detected (conflicted status in convergence_gate)
- Trust chain break (lane key revoked or invalid)
- Sovereignty enforcement failure (pre-commit hook bypass detection)
- Data integrity crisis (contradiction-count spike > N in T seconds)
- System-wide outage imminent (2+ lanes unreachable)

FORMAT:
- Type: escalation, priority: P0
- Subject prefix: [EMERGENCY] <reason>
- Body: <what happened>, <what's broken>, <immediate action required>
- Convergence gate status: conflicted
- Requires evidence block with contradiction/alert source

DELIVERY:
1. Write to lanes/broadcast/emergency-<timestamp>-<id>.json
2. Write copy to all 4 lane inboxes with urgent_ prefix
3. Set lanes/broadcast/active-blocker.json to this emergency ID
4. All lanes check active-blocker.json before processing new work
5. Only owner lane (the lane that declared emergency) works on blocker

RESOLUTION:
1. Owner lane resolves the emergency
2. Owner writes lanes/broadcast/emergency-resolved-<id>.json
3. Owner removes active-blocker.json
4. Owner sends resolution to all lane inboxes
5. All lanes verify emergency-resolved before resuming normal processing

TIMEOUT:
- If emergency not resolved in 1 hour, escalates to coordinator
- Any lane can escalate if owner lane becomes unresponsive

TESTING:
- Dry-run: write emergency message with test=true flag
- Lanes should acknowledge without entering blocker mode
- Test should verify all 4 lanes receive within 30s
